name: EAAA India Alternatives Limited
summary: Edelweiss group's alternative asset manager (infrastructure, real estate, private credit) earning management, advisory and performance fees; 100% offer for sale.
financials: FY26 revenue ₹870 Cr (+30%), PAT ₹265 Cr (+15%); Q1 FY27 revenue ₹276 Cr, PAT ₹81 Cr; net worth ₹1,076 Cr.
positives: Fast revenue growth (FY24 ₹493 Cr to FY26 ₹870 Cr)
Asset-light fee model with ROE of about 25%
Debt-light balance sheet against ₹1,160 Cr equity
red_flags: 100% OFS by promoter ESIPL: no money to the company, promoter holding 89.6% pre-issue
Profit leans on unrealised fair-value gains (₹290 Cr in FY26); operating cash flow is lumpy
P/E about 41 on FY26 for a cyclical fee business
anchor: Anchor bidding 23 Oct is not yet confirmed; pending
